card.name: Worsening toward a severe outcome
card.fires_on: The word "to" after progress, progression or progressing, and the word piece "itating" in precipitating, in warnings about disease getting worse. The next words name a severe condition such as liver failure or coma.

modes.label: progress to
modes.description: The word "to" right after progress, progressing or progression, before a worse condition.
modes.example: JUXTAPID may induce steatohepatitis, which can progress<< to>> cirrhosis over several years.

modes.label: precipitating
modes.description: The ending of the word precipitating, when a drug or condition brings on something worse.
modes.example: beta blockade carries the potential hazard of further depressing myocardial contractility and precip<<itating>> more severe failure.

card.writes: It adds words that name an outcome or a worsening state that follows.
card.plain: It marks the point in a warning where one condition is said to turn into or bring on a worse one.
